references.text: Earlier instructions regarding the amount of fine flour mixed with oil to accompany the burnt offering, which provide the basis for the measurements mentioned in Numbers 28:12.
Corresponding regulations for grain offerings with fine flour mixed with oil at festival sacrifices, reflecting the instructions for monthly offerings.
Basic regulations for grain offerings (mincha) of fine flour mixed with oil, serving as the foundation for all later grain offering instructions.
Regulations concerning grain offerings of fine flour mixed with oil, demonstrating the enduring practice of such sacrifices.
Early regulation regarding grain offerings with fine flour mixed with oil to accompany the daily burnt offering.
Ezekiel's prophetic vision includes similar regulations about grain offerings with flour mixed with oil.
